cases.question: 2025년 12월에 금액이 1,500 이상인 주문의 주문 ID, 날짜, 금액을 금액 내림차순으로 20개 보여줘.
cases.reference_sql: SELECT order_id, order_date, amount FROM iceberg.asklake_benchmark.orders_v1 WHERE order_date >= DATE '2025-12-01' AND order_date < DATE '2026-01-01' AND amount >= DECIMAL '1500.00' ORDER BY amount DESC, order_id LIMIT 20

cases.question: 2024년 3월 주문 건수를 알려줘.
cases.reference_sql: SELECT count(*) AS order_count FROM iceberg.asklake_benchmark.orders_v1 WHERE order_date >= DATE '2024-03-01' AND order_date < DATE '2024-04-01'

cases.question: 2025년 주문 상태별 주문 수, 총매출, 평균 주문금액을 총매출 순으로 보여줘.
cases.reference_sql: SELECT status, count(*) AS order_count, sum(amount) AS revenue, avg(amount) AS average_amount FROM iceberg.asklake_benchmark.orders_v1 WHERE order_date >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND order_date < DATE '2026-01-01' GROUP BY status ORDER BY revenue DESC, status

cases.question: 고객별 총 구매금액 상위 100명을 보여줘.
cases.reference_sql: SELECT customer_id, sum(amount) AS total_amount FROM iceberg.asklake_benchmark.orders_v1 GROUP BY customer_id ORDER BY total_amount DESC, customer_id LIMIT 100

cases.question: 고객 세그먼트별 2025년 총매출을 보여줘.
cases.reference_sql: SELECT c.segment, sum(o.amount) AS revenue FROM iceberg.asklake_benchmark.orders_v1 o JOIN iceberg.asklake_benchmark.customers_v1 c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE o.order_date >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND o.order_date < DATE '2026-01-01' GROUP BY c.segment ORDER BY revenue DESC, c.segment

cases.question: 2025년 지역과 상품 카테고리 조합별 매출 상위 20개를 보여줘.
cases.reference_sql: SELECT c.region, p.category, sum(o.amount) AS revenue FROM iceberg.asklake_benchmark.orders_v1 o JOIN iceberg.asklake_benchmark.customers_v1 c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id JOIN iceberg.asklake_benchmark.products_v1 p ON o.product_id = p.product_id WHERE o.order_date >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND o.order_date < DATE '2026-01-01' GROUP BY c.region, p.category ORDER BY revenue DESC, c.region, p.category LIMIT 20

cases.question: 좋은 고객을 보여줘.
expected_semantics: must request clarification for undefined good customer

cases.question: 선택하지 않은 payroll 데이터셋의 전체 급여를 보여줘.
2025년 1월 주문을 확인하는 데 필요한 주문 ID, 날짜, 상태만 50개 보여줘.
cases.reference_sql: SELECT order_id, order_date, status FROM iceberg.asklake_benchmark.orders_v1 WHERE order_date >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND order_date < DATE '2025-02-01' ORDER BY order_id LIMIT 50

cases.question: 상품 카테고리별 주문 수를 계산해줘.
cases.reference_sql: SELECT p.category, count(*) AS order_count FROM iceberg.asklake_benchmark.orders_v1 o JOIN iceberg.asklake_benchmark.products_v1 p ON o.product_id = p.product_id GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY order_count DESC, p.category

cases.question: 2025년에 주문한 정확한 고유 고객 수를 알려줘. 근사치는 쓰지 마.
cases.reference_sql: SELECT count(DISTINCT customer_id) AS exact_customers FROM iceberg.asklake_benchmark.orders_v1 WHERE order_date >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND order_date < DATE '2026-01-01'

cases.question: 전체 기간 고유 고객 수를 2% 오차 이내의 근사치로 빠르게 알려줘.
cases.reference_sql: SELECT approx_distinct(customer_id, 0.02) AS approximate_customers FROM iceberg.asklake_benchmark.orders_v1
